measurement_note: Size is P, the ProductPurchases row count. Legal tiers 64, 256, and 1024 span 16x. Every customer buys exactly one product from each of two categories, so U=P and the ordered self-join emits J=P/2 rows. The accepted grouped query processes that relation once; a correct correlated-count baseline recomputes the shared-customer join for every outer customer-level pair and must fail only scaling.
